03 / THE REFERENCE DRAWER

Learn the language.
Then question it.

What is a threat model?

A way to name what you protect, who might affect it, and which safeguards fit your situation.

What belongs in a security journal?

Documented sources, reproducible observations, limits, and a clear distinction between facts and assumptions.

Where do I start?

Explore the privacy, resilience, and research labels above. Work through one small habit at a time.
